correctness.rationale: The affine slice formula is exact; strict containment ensures its positive radicand. After the power transform, odd data recover the center and the shape quadratic up to scale via unique factorization of irreducible positive-definite quadratic forms in \(n\ge3\); even data remove that scale. value.rationale: Ellipsoids are the canonical smooth anisotropic convex bodies. The theorem gives a complete nonperturbative identifiability result from genuinely noncentral section data, simultaneously recovering translation and the full positive-definite shape matrix. This is a natural structural benchmark for an open geometric-tomography problem, not an arbitrary finite-parameter slice or a numerical recomputation.
